entities.name: Query GlmU
observations: 479 aa bacterial enzyme candidate with 57.8% identity and ~95% query coverage to reviewed GlmU homologs.
Pfam supports an N-terminal NTP-transferase/pyrophosphorylase region (PF00483/PF12804) and a C-terminal Hexapep-associated acetyltransferase region.
Predicted cytoplasmic protein; no transmembrane or secretion features were reported.
Likely homotrimer based on close reviewed GlmU homologs, but oligomerization is homology-based for this query.

entities.name: GlmU
observations: Bifunctional enzyme catalyzing glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activities.
N-terminal pyrophosphorylase domain produces UDP-GlcNAc from GlcNAc-1-phosphate and UTP; C-terminal acetyltransferase domain produces GlcNAc-1-phosphate from GlcN-1-phosphate and acetyl-CoA.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ per subunit and are cytoplasmic homotrimers.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: GlmU catalyzes the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis in bacteria.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: UDP-GlcNAc supplied by GlmU is used in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: UDP-GlcNAc supplied by GlmU contributes to bacterial lipid A and outer-membrane biogenesis in organisms possessing these pathways.
